features.featureTitle: Update the PaymentGate frontend component to automatically poll or trigger `verifyAndActivate()` after the user copies the payment address or clicks a 'I have paid' / 'Check Payment' button. Display a loading state while verification is in progress, a success message when the account is activated, and a clear error message (e.g., 'No payment found yet — please wait a moment and try again') if no qualifying payment is detected. The existing 30-second activation status polling (useActivationQueries) should continue so the gate dismisses automatically once activation is confirmed.
Add a `verifyAndActivate` method to the frontend actor interface and expose a corresponding React Query mutation in useActivationQueries.ts so components can call it without direct actor access.
